gameMeta.title: Convoy Clash
gameMeta.description: Grid-based auto-battler where players deploy car units, then watch tactical combat unfold

special.name: Hit and Run
special.description: Moves 3 tiles per turn, excellent kiting potential

rockPaperScissors.reasoning: Kites slow tanks; dies to area denial

special.name: Balanced Fighter
special.description: No special ability; solid all-around stats

special.name: Steel Plating
special.description: Reduces all damage by 25%; immobile but devastating at close range

rockPaperScissors.reasoning: Too slow to catch scouts; crushes slower units

special.name: Artillery Strike
special.description: Longest range in game; one hit kills most units but dies fast

rockPaperScissors.reasoning: Outranges most; pulled into melee by harpoon

special.name: Reel In
special.description: On hit, pulls target 2 tiles closer; breaks long-range dominance

rockPaperScissors.reasoning: Negates ranged advantage; can't pull heavy armor far

special.name: Minefield
special.description: Plants mines in 2-tile radius; enemies take 20 damage entering field (one-time)

rockPaperScissors.reasoning: Denies fast/melee units area; outgunned by ranged

phases.name: Deployment
phases.description: Player drags units onto grid (6 cols x 2 rows bottom side)
rules: Each unit costs supply points (total pool: ~6-8 points)
Can field 3-6 units total
Units must be placed in bottom 2 rows
Enemy auto-deploys mirror composition

phases.name: Initiative
rules: Speed ties broken by unit type priority (Tanks > Ranged > Utility > Fast)
Turn order displayed in UI for clarity

phases.name: Movement
phases.description: Units move toward enemies based on positioning AI
rules: Melee units move to close distance (if range <= 1)
Ranged units move to maintain distance (prefer range >= 3)
Harpoon cars move to intercept high-priority targets
Mine layers hold position and deploy mines (triggers auto-deploy)
Each unit moves exactly (speed) tiles per turn

phases.name: Combat
rules: Attack in speed order (fastest first)
Each unit can attack once per round if target in range
Range measured as grid distance (Chebyshev/max of x,y delta)
Harpoon car pulls target 2 tiles toward self after hit
Mine layer triggers automatic explosion on enemy entering minefield
Heavy Rig armor reduces damage: final_damage = base_damage * 0.75
Damage applied immediately; dead units don't get to attack

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.description: Remove destroyed units, resolve mine triggers
rules: Units with HP <= 0 removed from battle
Harpoon pull happens mid-phase and can trigger mines on destination
Next round begins immediately

priorities.condition: Target with lowest HP in range (execute kills)
Target that is strongest unit in range (disable threats)
Random unit in range if no clear winner

meleeUnits.strategy: Close to nearest enemy, prioritize weak units
meleeUnits.pathfinding: Move toward closest enemy each turn

rangedUnits.strategy: Maintain distance, fire at closest high-priority target
rangedUnits.pathfinding: Move to maximize range advantage vs nearest threat

tankUnits.strategy: Move toward enemy front line, block damage for allies
tankUnits.pathfinding: Move toward center of enemy group

controlUnits.pathfinding: Move to intercept rocket jeeps and gun trucks

timeout.trigger: Battle reaches 3 minutes without clear winner
timeout.resolution: Unit with higher remaining HP% declared winner

costBalance.note: Total budget ~7-8 points allows varied compositions

designPhilosophy: Each unit has a clear role and counter-role
Rock-paper-scissors extends to 6 units, not just 3
Speed stat creates tactical depth in turn order
Special abilities are simple but impactful (pull, mines, armor)
No RNG in combat (deterministic for player learning)

keyModules.name: BattleLoop
keyModules.responsibility: Phase management, unit movement, attack resolution

keyModules.name: Renderer/UI
keyModules.responsibility: Display grid, units, battle log, results
